Rooms: the single water area of 2-2 is split into five rooms ([0,1,0]..[0,1,4], 43K/34K/29K/30K/15K entries) because a job's boundaries are completed against the last retained entry, and a spliced job from the land start replays a known path whose early water boundaries are all rejected (full slots), so the first boundary that lands in a fresh slot at page k opens room [0,1,k]; the same positions then get five copies of every cell.
